title: Mouth tape works, even for your jawline
claim: Taping your mouth shut at night is a proven fix, including for a sharper jawline.
harm_reason: A 2025 review of 10 studies (213 patients) says clinical benefit still needs study and warns of a potentially serious risk of harm, including asphyxiation when the nose is blocked.
match_note: Exact phrases "mouth taping", "mouth tape", "tape my mouth" or "taping my mouth" in transcript, caption or on-screen text. Transcript only: 65 videos, 2,929,555 views. Many are jokes or ads, so stance labels matter.

top_video.quote: I feel like it really has helped me with like snatching my jaw because you sleep with your mouth closed and it really helps.
